versions.changelog:
- Initial release of uniapp-test skill.
- Provides a specialized, step-by-step workflow for uni-app / uni-app x automated testing: page analysis, test case generation, running and repairing tests.
- Supports test targeting for `.uvue`/`.vue` pages under `pages/`, and generates/updates corresponding `*.test.js` files.
- Outlines recommended use of selectors, event testing, and proper test case structure.
- Documents full test execution commands for major platforms (Web, Android, iOS, 鸿蒙, 微信小程序) and relevant test runner parameters.
- Includes troubleshooting guidance and strict coding constraints for reliable automated testing.
